build_mlp_vit: build a two-layer MLP module for Vision Transformer with GELU activation and configurable hidden features
create_mlp_conv: create an MLP using 1x1 convolutions instead of linear layers for NCHW tensor inputs
test_mlp_forward: test the Mlp forward pass with a random input tensor and verify output shape

review_mlp_dropout: review the Mlp class dropout configuration and bias settings for both fc1 and fc2 layers
